tool_args.rationale: The largest observed sink gradient is 2.44, below the proposed onset range of 2.50–2.68. The high-gradient probe is the cheapest direct test of whether the response follows the smooth baseline or incurs an additional loss above threshold.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the threshold avalanche law now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All observations are below the candidate threshold, so neither the threshold nor the post-threshold loss rate can be estimated.
The pilot varies drive and sink gradient together. Its flattening cannot distinguish smooth saturation or inhibition from a separate threshold effect.
It costs more and does not directly target the missing above-threshold regime.
